<a name="GitRepository"></a>
## type GitRepository

GitRepository

Declares a source repository the platform is permitted to observe. The controller registers provider webhooks on reconciliation and emits GitHubPayload resources for matching events. Head of the pipeline chain:

```
GitRepository → GitHubEvent → Build → SupplyChain → Package → Deployment
```

Supported providers:

```
github      — webhook registration via GitHub App
gitlab      — webhook registration via project hooks
bitbucket   — webhook registration via repository hooks
generic-git — poll-only, no webhook registration
```

Resource

```go
type GitRepository struct {

    // Standard BlanketOps metadata (name, namespace, labels, ownerRef).
    Metadata *v1.Metadata `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=metadata,proto3" json:"metadata,omitempty"`
    // Desired state declared by the operator.
    Spec *GitRepositorySpec `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=spec,proto3" json:"spec,omitempty"`
    // Observed state set by the controller. Never manually edited.
    Status *GitRepositoryStatus `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=status,proto3" json:"status,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="GitRepositoryServiceClient"></a>
## type GitRepositoryServiceClient

GitRepositoryServiceClient is the client API for GitRepositoryService service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

Service

```go
type GitRepositoryServiceClient interface {
    // Declare a new GitRepository intent.
    // Controller registers provider webhooks on reconciliation.
    CreateGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *CreateGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CreateGitRepositoryResponse, error)
    // Fetch a GitRepository CR by name.
    GetGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *GetGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*GetGitRepositoryResponse, error)
    // Full replace of a GitRepository spec.
    UpdateGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UpdateGitRepositoryResponse, error)
    // Partial update via JSON merge patch RFC 7396.
    PatchGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *PatchGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*PatchGitRepositoryResponse, error)
    // List GitRepository CRs with optional provider/owner/ready filter and paging.
    ListGitRepositories(ctx context.Context, in *ListGitRepositoriesRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ListGitRepositoriesResponse, error)
    // Delete a GitRepository CR and deregister its provider webhooks.
    DeleteGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*DeleteGitRepositoryResponse, error)
    // Force webhook re-registration against the provider.
    // Useful after provider-side hook deletion or credential rotation.
    SyncGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *SyncGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*SyncGitRepositoryResponse, error)
    WatchGitRepository(ctx context.Context, in *WatchGitRepositoryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ServerStreamingClient[WatchGitRepositoryResponse], error)
}
```
